svg.aria-label: plan-depth: the plan standard at prompt time, its gaps at ExitPlanMode
svg.text: plan-depth: the plan standard at prompt time, its gaps at ExitPlanMode

text.tspan: # Plan mode, first human prompt of the session: the standard is injected as context

g.text: hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName: UserPromptSubmit
hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext:
[plan-depth] Plan mode: a plan with 3+ tasks or features needs:
1 How: numbered build steps under every feature (files, the code reused with path:line, commands, formats)
2 Verification log: every claim the plan depends on, marked confirmed, refuted or unclear, with evidence (a
URL, a path:line or a probe)
3 Unknowns -> tests: every unknown becomes a scheduled test with a pass threshold
4 Questions log: the decision-maker's answers word for word, or a "no open decisions" line
5 Independent review: a fresh reviewer checks the plan before it is presented; record it in a "Reviewed-by:"
line
6 Dispatch plan: a table: each stage, who does it, where it runs, a reason for every manual row; and a load
line per phase
7 Prior art: what already exists (docs, packages, GitHub) and what is reused or rejected, and why
8 Coverage checklist: safety, privacy, security, portability, failure modes, rollback, cost, host impact, ob
servability, tests, manual steps, records, clean-up, follow-ups: each covered or N/A with a reason
A big plan (more than 10 stages or 800 lines) also needs:
9 Context and succession: the measured context baseline of a fresh session, a rough context cost per stage,
the named hand-over points, and where each stage runs (this session, a successor session, a subagent)

text.tspan: # ExitPlanMode on a thin plan: each gap is listed (its one-line systemMessage is omitted here).
# Warn only: there is no permissionDecision, so the user still approves the plan as usual.

g.text: hookSpecificOutput.hookEventName: PreToolUse
hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext:
[plan-depth] The plan is missing:
- How (numbered build steps) for: Data import; Summary report; CSV export
- Verification log section
- Unknowns -> tests section
- Questions log section (or a "no open decisions" line)
- Independent review (a "Reviewed-by:" line)
- Dispatch plan section
- Prior art section
- Coverage checklist section
Fix these or say why each doesn't apply, then present again. (Warn only; nothing is blocked.)

text.tspan: # A plan that meets the standard: no gaps (as a hook it prints nothing at all)
